data.name: Saalima
data.gender_notes: Saalima is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Saalima is derived from the Arabic word 'salama' which means 'to be safe and secure'. It symbolizes peace, tranquility, and protection. The name Saalima carries the meaning “Peaceful, Calm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Saalima usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful, calm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Choosing the name Saalima for your daughter signifies a prayer for her peaceful life and a desire to protect her from harm.
data.etymology: Saalima belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peaceful, Calm.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saalima total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: سليمة
in_arabic.meaning: سليمة تعني السالمة من كل شر أو العافية التامة للإنسان
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سليمة مشتق من الجذر العربي سلِم، ويعني السالمة من كل شر أو العافية التامة للإنسان. ورد ذكر هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَيُسَلِّمُكُمْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ' (الأنفال: 79). يدل هذا الاسم على معنى السلام والخليق من العيوب

in_urdu.name: سلیمہ
in_urdu.meaning: سلیمہ کا مطلب ہے سلامت رہنے والی یا مکمل عافیت والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: سلیمہ نام عربی جڑ سلِم سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سلامت رہنے والی یا مکمل عافیت والی۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ انفال میں: 'وَيُسَلِّمُكُمْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ' (الأنفال: 79)۔ یہ نام سلامتی اور خلیقی سے متعلق ہے

in_hindi.name: सलीमा
in_hindi.meaning: सलीमा का अर्थ है सलामती से रहने वाली या पूरी तरह से सुरक्षित
in_hindi.long_meaning: सलीमा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सलामती से रहने वाली या पूरी तरह से सुरक्षित। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी मिलता है, जैसे कि सूरा अल-अनफाल में: 'وَيُسَلِّمُكُمْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ' (الأنفال: 79)। यह नाम शांति और सुरक्षा की भावना को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: سالمہ
in_pashto.meaning: سالمہ داسې معنی لري چې کومه ښځه له هر ډول بدۍ څخه سالم پاتې شي
in_pashto.long_meaning: د سلیمہ نوم مطلب داسې دی چې کومه ښځه له هر ډول بدۍ څخه سالم پاتې شي یا بشپړه روغتیا ولري. په قرآن کریم کې ددې نوم اصل 'سلِم' ریشه ذکر شوی دی، لکه د انعام سوره کې: 'وَيُسَلِّمُكُمْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ' (الأنفال: 79). دا نوم د سولې او بشپړتیا مفهوم څرګندوي

in_english.name: Saalima
in_english.meaning: Saalima means peaceful, safe, and sound, free from harm
in_english.long_meaning: The name Saalima originates from the Arabic root 'سلِم' (salima), which conveys the meaning of being peaceful, safe, and sound, free from harm. This root is mentioned in the Quran, such as in Surah Al-Anfal: 'وَيُسَلِّمُكُمْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ' (8:79). The name Saalima signifies a person who embodies peace, security, and wholeness. It reflects a spiritual aspiration for serenity and protection. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing good fortune and divine blessings

pronunciation.pashto: د سلیمہ تلفظ داسې دی: ساه-لی-مه

data.cultural_impact: The name Saalima carries a sense of safety and security, not only for the individual but also for their loved ones. It is a name that evokes feelings of comfort and stability. In Islamic communities, naming a child Saalima is believed to bring blessings of peace and protection upon the child throughout their life. The name's cultural impact is one of reassurance and security.
data.spiritual_significance: Saalima is a name that holds spiritual significance in Islam as it embodies the concept of ceremonial and spiritual security. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) once said, "The believer's shield is in Allah and his faith, and his fortress is to be patient andfaced with the trials" (Muslim). Saalima serves as a reminder of the protection and security that faith and a strong relationship with Allah can provide. It is a name that represents spiritual strength during times of adversity and hardship, and a reminder of the peace and tranquility that comes from a deep connection with the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Saalima in Arabic means "tender, gentle, kind, or compassionate." It is a beautiful name for a child, symbolizing a gentle soul with a loving heart. In the spiritual sense, Saalima is a reminder to always show kindness and compassion to others, reflecting the mercy and love of Allah (God) towards His creation.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Tabari, The History of al-Tabari, vol. 3, p. 183 The name Saalima carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Sa'id ibn Jubayr narrated that Saalima bint Suhayl was the wife of Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Saalima remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
